interface.longDescription: Software Engineering Toolkit is an adapted multi-skill engineering toolkit inspired by Matt Pocock's open-source skills repository. It helps agents and developers align on intent, model the domain, write specs and tickets, design deep modules, use test-driven development, diagnose bugs, review code, research with citations, create handoffs, and improve codebase architecture.
